message: Hey neighbors! So, I recently stumbled upon a resource that’s all about home fire safety. It's packed with practical tips and a few light-hearted reminders that getting prepared doesn’t have to be a chore. You know, it’s kind of funny how we often think, "Oh, that’ll never happen to me!" until it does. 😅 Just a little prep can go a long way in keeping our homes cozy and safe! What’s your favorite way to stay prepared?
